caption: The drawing features two depictions of a dress, both shown from the back. The primary dress, centered and larger, is rendered in detail using black and red lines on a beige background. The dress has a fitted bodice with a squared neckline and long, slightly puffed sleeves. Its full skirt is pleated and reaches the ground. The fabric of the dress is decorated with an intricate floral and geometric pattern drawn in red, covering the entire surface. To the upper right of the main dress, there is a smaller, less detailed outline sketch of the same dress in black pencil, without any interior pattern or shading. The smaller sketch serves as a simpler depiction of the garment's construction, contrasting with the ornate, patterned main drawing. The overall composition is on an uncolored, plain sheet with no additional objects or background elements.
title: Dress
